D012-D021_h001.question:
I’ve always been high-strung, but ever since my startup started collapsing, things have gotten worse. I can’t sleep, my chest tightens at the thought of investors pulling out, and honestly, I just don’t feel like eating. It’s that every bite feels like I’m betraying my goals. Gaining weight feels like failure—like losing control, like going soft when everything else is falling apart. I run every morning, no matter how tired I am. If I skip it, I panic—like I’ve already started to let myself go.  

Yeah, I get scared during thunderstorms, and I hate heights—my heart races the second I’m on a high floor. But that’s different. That fear doesn’t drive me to skip dinner. This… this is about staying sharp, lean, in control. Food is the enemy because it makes me fat. And I can’t afford to be fat—not now, not ever.
